context: Review 2026-11-12 item 12.5 (decision D11). The brief tool carries the product prefix so it does not clash with other servers' brief tools; the rest are plain verbs.
decision: Leave the mixed MCP names (sati_brief beside task_list, recall, search) unchanged. Renaming every tool to one scheme would break each installed rules block and every agent that learned the names; only roadmap_upsert gets a new name (milestone_upsert), and the old one stays registered.
title: Keep MCP tool names as they are, with and without a prefix (review 12.5)
